title: Holiday magazine on Sharkey; the cold Chicago engagement
summary: The magazine says New Orleans thinks of Sharkey for white jazz; Riddick describes a freezing month at the Empire Room in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: They mentioned Shaw. Yeah, yeah, see. See, when in New Orleans, when New Orleans thinks of white jazz group, it automatically thinks of Joseph Schock at Banana.
Mm-hmm. He played at the Roosevelt, that's a...
Crowd swarmed to see Francis. I don't know what Francis... That's Joe Reichman. Yeah, Joe Reichman. There's been... There's been... There's been... Sharky Banana and his Dixieland band, and all that.
That's gotta be the picky in it.
What was the Empire Room like? I was never there.

Well... I don't know that you could say it was very, very homely or anything like that. We knew no one there, and never did get to know anyone. We were there a month, and no one was... We were another act, and that was what it was. But we got plenty, plenty, plenty of extra engagements through working there, in Chicago, and around there. Mm-hmm. Sometimes they... But it was so bitterly cold that truthfully we didn't... We wished that we didn't have any other jobs otherwise than that.

It was... We were just not equipped for it. We were not used to it. We nearly froze to death up there. And we were there... When we got on the train, we could have worn a T-shirt, and when we got off the train, we needed boots and everything. It was... It had come a blizzard that night up there. Scoop Kennedy?
Oh, yeah. I remember him. Mike Fritzel's has a beautiful restaurant there. It says in the Palmer House. Guys, week beginning December 30, 1950. Yeah, I don't know what this is.
I don't know. No. I think that's... Maybe you saved it for the fishing reel.
It's that same holiday magazine. It just got separated. Yes. Holiday of May. It's credited to Delanyap Thomas. That's got to be Tommy Griffin.
Yeah. It just takes too long to go into it to find out the details about it. Sure.
I wouldn't have cut it out if it hadn't had something to do with it, though.
